---
title: "Listings in Quarto"
subtitle: "Organizing portfolio content for future growth"
---

## What Is a Listing?

A Quarto listing is a structured collection of documents, posts, projects, or other content that Quarto automatically displays as a searchable or filterable list. Listings are useful when a website will grow over time because new content can be added without manually redesigning the homepage.

## How Listings Could Support My Portfolio

For a digital marketing portfolio, a listing could organize:

- Analytics and dashboard projects
- Paid media campaign analyses
- SEO and content strategy work
- Coursework and data visualizations
- Professional reflections and case studies

## Example Listing Configuration

The following example shows the basic structure that could be added to a future Quarto page.

```yaml
listing:
  contents: projects
  type: grid
  fields: [title, description, date]
  sort: "date desc"
  categories: true
  sort-ui: true
  filter-ui: true
```

This configuration tells Quarto to collect project files from a folder, display them in a grid, show selected fields, and provide sorting and filtering controls.

## Customer-Oriented Value

Listings improve the visitor experience by helping an audience find the information that matters to them. A recruiter could filter for analytics work, a marketing manager could review campaign projects, and a professor could quickly locate coursework.

::: {.callout-note}
### Future extension

The next version of this portfolio could add a `projects/` folder and use a listing page to display each project as a visual case study with a title, short summary, tools, and measurable outcome.
:::
